about.title: About Club Med Columbus
about.text: Club Med Columbus Bahamas offers a surreal, secluded stay with boundless white sand beaches alongside infinite blue water. Located in the pristine Bonefish Bay, our all-inclusive resort provides world-class amenities, water sports, fine dining, and unforgettable experiences. Escape the ordinary and discover paradise with us.
